purpose: Formal MedicalHarness MedTool restricted-adapter two-block HCL pilot; no original full-environment replication
model: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct BF16 sdpa frozen, same Static/HCL; fresh empty workflow; no synthetic learned state imported
transport: Qwen-Agent pinned official Nous; no format-repair retries
stages: fixed shuffled formal task block one
fixed shuffled formal task block two

data.limitation: Package IDs distinct; biological patient independence not established. Randomized fixed task blocks, not disease-defined task stages. Heldout8 score is not a full32 benchmark score. Public benchmark pretraining contamination not ruled out.
data.fixtures: exact upstream builder env_private root_inputs plus distractors; final_answer never put in model facts
data.prompt: official export prompt with only file/SQLite delivery instructions replaced by read_facts/submit_answer and fixed24-turn statement

updates.only: separate versioned workflow prose; no initial handcrafted corrective hint
updates.method: official Nous propose_workflow schema; actual hcl Optimizer normalization/ranking/strict gate reused, generator adapted
updates.boundary: numeric examples/code/placeholders/override instructions rejected; immutable tools enforce access
updates.feedback: current-stage training only; last12 non-read-facts events; tool content capped500 chars; full original traces retained. No selection/anchor/final inputs or answers to proposer.

commit_gate.gate: actual stability optimizer; no screening; deterministic argmax tie first; wrong candidate no update
commit_gate.reason_for_metric: formal multi-output clinical tasks; official utility primary and complete-task success also reported; fixed before first model call

retention: stage1 initial4 anchors; stage2 initial4 plus independent4; compare each gold output and complete-task success with deployed previous state; no offsetting lost correct outputs; report zero-success limitations
confirmation: only after both stages, Static H0 then final frozen HCL on same8 independent tasks; no checkpoint or candidate selection from confirmation
signal_gate: at least one accepted automatic update, average task utility delta>=.05 and paired task-bootstrap95 lower bound>0, no previously correct Static output or full task lost; every stage has >0 historical correct outputs. Also report complete-task McNemar and per-block metrics. Small pilot, not clinical efficacy.

budget.restarts: none automatic; preparation/CPU/model runs share original clock

failure: per-episode context/turn/unsubmitted recorded failed; global budget/guard/provider failure stops run incomplete, no partial candidate commit; no automatic retry
scope_exclusions: clinical formula library or new tool training
guard: On du return1 only when every diagnostic is a vanished relative *.tmp, perform at most3 fresh complete scans per size mode. Never accept partial counts or ignore live temporary files. Permissions/I/O/timeout/other failures stop. Both actual allocation and apparent size counted, larger plus reserve.
